task.title: Deploy a Kubernetes application with a Deployment and Service
task.shortdesc: Create a Deployment and expose it with a Service to run an application on a Kubernetes cluster.

step.cmd: Create a namespace for the application (optional): kubectl create namespace <ns>.
Create a Deployment: kubectl create deployment <app> --image=<image> -n <ns>.
Verify Pods are created: kubectl get pods -n <ns> -l app=<app>.
Expose the Deployment with a Service: kubectl expose deployment <app> --port=<port> --target-port=<targetPort> -n <ns>.
Confirm the Service is created: kubectl get svc -n <ns>.
Test connectivity (cluster-internal): kubectl run tmp --rm -it --image=curlimages/curl -n <ns> -- curl http://<serviceName>:<port>/.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
